lines.text: Whoever sows generously will reap generously, and God loves a cheerful giver.
God is able to make all grace abound so that you abound in every good work.
God supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, and will increase the harvest of your wisdom.
Your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God, and this service meets the needs of the prophets.
The saints will glorify God for obedient confession of the gospel, and thanks be to God for His indescribable gift.
